full_judgment: 12. It appears that the petitioner was the managing partner of Messrs Dhaka Scientific Works, a firm. The Dhakeswari Cotton Mills Limited, a company in liquidation, owned the properties at the holding Nos. 27 and 28, Hatkhola Road, Dhaka. The board of directors of the company in its meeting held on 28-12-1963 authorised its managing director, the respondent No.3, to sell its aforesaid properties to the firm. In due course the petitioner, acting on behalf of the firm, entered into two separate agreements with the company in order to purchase its properties at the aforesaid holding Nos. 27 and 28, Hatkhola Road, Dhaka. On receipt of Taka 55,000 by the vendor out of the total consideration of Taka 70,000 the agreement to purchase the properties at  the holding No. 28, Hatkhola was made on 13-11-1964 (Annexure B) and Khas possession of the said property was also handed over to the vendor. The said payment of Taka 55,000 made on behalf of the firm was duly acknowledged by company (Annexure C).
